verdict.rationale: Omarchy's own docs describe an Install > Development menu that sets up 'a whole host of development environments.' Named examples include Ruby on Rails, Laravel and Node.js, with Mise managing per-project language versions. Editors such as VSCode, Cursor and Zed are also ready to install. missing for 10: a complete documented list of supported frameworks and languages with what each setup preconfigures, and independent or hands-on corroboration specific to the dev-environment installers.
